prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (237.6), dominating both early and late horizons. ONLY_DWT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.603 correlation). Extreme model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 15.3) combined with unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.0058) and concept drift warrant robust median/trimmed-mean combination over stacking. All models show autocorrelated residuals, indicating exploitable structure remains.
